title: Uwell Viscore Milky Strawberry Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Uwell Viscore Prefilled Pod & Refill in Milky Strawberry combines the ripe sweetness of strawberries with a creamy milk note, offering a sweet and mellow vape. Designed for the Uwell Viscore 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, this pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container for extended convenience and value. Equipped with a 0.8ohm mesh coil, the pod delivers rich flavour and smooth vapour, ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. The refill container ensures quick and hassle-free top-ups, providing up to 8000 puffs, depending on personal usage. Preloaded with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod offers a silky throat hit and rapid nicotine absorption, making it a great choice for adult vapers seeking a satisfying and long-lasting vaping experience. Replace the pod and refill container when empty to continue enjoying the cool, fruity Strawberry Ice flavour.
